source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: Igniter is a framework for generating and patching Elixir code: the Mix tasks (install, upgrade, gen.task) rely on lib/mix/task.ex and the core lib/igniter.ex. The core applies semantic changes to the dependencies, the configuration and the modules of the target project.
